_comment: Pinned retrieval configuration under which all Chapter 5 trials were executed. Environment-variable names match app/services/embedding_service.py and app/models/mandard_models.py at the baseline commit.

generation.temperature: 0.3 when max_tokens is used; not accepted by reasoning-class deployments using max_completion_tokens
generation.reproducibility_note: Generation is not reproducible token-for-token: no seed is fixed and the deployment may be updated by the provider. Model-independent results (corpus synthesis metrics, static finding counts, the detection and citation audit) replicate exactly; model-conditioned results (semantic findings, the 80 Sage consultations, response-contract counts, failure modes F4-F6) may differ. See s3.8 Model Dependence and Reproducibility.

degradation_guard.effect_if_unset: No vector embeddings are generated and retrieval silently falls back to tsvector keyword search, exercising none of the RAG architecture.
degradation_guard.why_published: Publication of this file is what allows a replicator to confirm that vector retrieval was active rather than silently degraded. See s3.4 and s3.8 (Internal Validity).
degradation_guard.verification: GET /health reports checks.embedding_provider; the active provider is echoed in the EmbeddingStatus schema (app/schemas/mandard_schemas.py).

transport.note: Earlier crAPI and WebGoat runs failed on an unavailable MCP endpoint and were re-executed; see the provenance note in s5.1.1.

detector_binding_note.rationale: AUTH-M-001 (Secure Password Hashing) is the only corpus record whose statement prohibits MD5 and SHA-1 by name. CRYPT-M-001 governs Encryption at Rest.
detector_binding_note.effect: 31 findings in codi_scan_reports/ carry the superseded CRYPT-M-001 citation as captured at execution time; Chapter 5 reports them under the corrected binding.
